title: Consolidate the ad hoc MaterialApp test-wrap helpers in story_21 and story_25_9 into a shared pumpApp

evidence.quote: Widget wrap({required AuthState authState, required Widget child}) =>

why: No shared, reviewed pumpApp helper exists yet (TQ-3 is still [Pending] repo-wide); each file hand-rolls its own MaterialApp wrapper and the two disagree on localization wiring — story_21's wrap() sets localizationsDelegates/supportedLocales but story_25_9's _wrap() sets neither. It only works today because the CurriculumLabel widgets under test in story_25_9 don't call AppLocalizations.of(context); the first future test added to that harness that does will throw MissingLocalizationsDelegate with no forcing function that would have caught it earlier.
recommendation: Add test/helpers/pump_app.dart with one canonical ProviderScope + MaterialApp(localizationsDelegates:, supportedLocales:) wrapper taking overrides + child, and migrate both local helpers onto it.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/pump_app.dart exists and both files call it instead of their local wrap/_wrap
a widget added to epic_25_story_25_9_test.dart that calls AppLocalizations.of(context) resolves without a missing-delegate error

corrections: Minor: a third ad hoc MaterialApp wrap exists in-batch at epic_25_story_25_20_locale_theme_test.dart (undercounts sites: 2 vs true 3+), and 'no shared pumpApp helper exists yet' overlooks test/e2e/harness/e2e_harness.dart's own pumpApp (different test tier, so not directly reusable, but the blanket claim is imprecise). Doesn't change the verdict.
